inputs.text: Folks, a jury in Wisconsin has convicted Harry Wait of two misdemeanor election fraud charges and one felony identity theft after he requested ballots without consent. He admitted he did this to prove how vulnerable the state's voter registration system is to fraud. Even though his group keeps getting smeared for questioning election integrity, the case shows just how wide open our elections are to abuse by anyone looking to exploit the system. The real scandal is the authorities going after this man for exposing the weakness instead of securing the process to protect our traditions, national order, and the rule of law. Progressive institutions would rather punish those highlighting the risks than fix them. We need stronger safeguards rooted in personal responsibility to preserve the integrity our country depends on.
